title: Molecular Biology
description: Life is chemistry that copies itself. Unlocks the Bioreactor, Nutrient Broth and the Gene Sampler.

puzzle.goal: Self-copying molecules in a sealed vessel multiply in proportion to how many copies already exist, with per-copy rate r. But the vessel holds only enough nucleotides for K copies, so copying slows as the population fills the available capacity. Write the rate of change of the number of copies N.
puzzle.name: Logistic growth equation (Verhulst)
puzzle.ask: The solution is N(t) = K / (1 + (K/N0 − 1)e^{−rt}). Starting from N0 = @{N0} copies with capacity K = @{K} and r = @{r} per hour, find N after t = @{t} hours.
puzzle.method: Exponential growth rN multiplied by the fraction of capacity still free, 1 − N/K.
